scope: New CSV tree exports and forestry Excel exports reachable from SettingsScreen; closed report and archive exporters are not modified.
problem: CSV called ForestryCalculator.volumeForTige; Excel called synthesisForEssence. These routes could emit a legacy fallback tariff and market-derived valuation without a qualified method catalog.
behavior: Both export routes now use ObservationExportCalculator, which delegates cubage to the existing SynthesisReportCalculator.
Real parcel context and session partitions are preserved; unknown, deleted or mismatched parents produce unavailable values with an explicit reason.
No tariff choice, method number, form coefficient, default height or price activates a formula in this adapter.
Existing V_m3/V_sum_m3/V_total_m3 numeric columns remain at their previous positions; unavailable cells are empty, never fabricated zeros.
V_statut is appended as a stable machine-readable reason column. Nonvolume CSV fields are preserved.
Excel keeps class counts and observed finite positive height means; class midpoint uses synthesisDiameterClass. Diameter mean excludes invalid diameters while observation counts retain them.
Excel Value_sum_EUR now sums only finite nonnegative entered values, including an entered zero, consistent with current Synthese; no default market valuation.
Deleted and duplicate observations follow the same live aggregate policy as Synthese; raw CSV rows are retained but deleted rows cannot receive a volume.
limits: No qualified cubage method catalog is wired to the current Synthese; new exports correctly expose unavailable volume until that shared policy can resolve one.
The new JVM tests still require the coordinated application build. Excel/CSV on-device export roundtrip is not yet executed.
Existing export-launcher account/access revalidation is outside this bounded calculation patch; repository access must be qualified in end-to-end release testing.
Previously captured closed reports and their archive transports are not recalculated or migrated by this change.
